job.title: ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG Technical Account Manager (all genders)

tailoring.headline: Technical Account Manager & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC APIs
tailoring.summary: Technical Account Manager and backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, and system integrations. Combines technical expertise with techno-functional consulting, requirements analysis, process mapping, and collaboration with international business and technical stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Technical Account Manager (all genders)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to apply for the Technical Account Manager position at ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG, bringing over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce and integration experience gained at Rockwell Automation and Shell. As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with a strong techno-functional background, I specialize in bridging the gap between complex technical architectures and business requirements.

bullets.label: Technical Integration & Architecture
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized complex data pipelines, OCC REST web services, and integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM platforms, ensuring seamless system synchronization and performance.

bullets.label: Stakeholder & Requirements Management
bullets.text: Worked extensively in techno-functional roles with international business and technical stakeholders, translating business requirements into robust e-commerce solutions and user stories.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Delivery
bullets.text: Delivered scalable backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211), covering product catalogs, pricing, and order management.

bullets.label: Production Support & Optimization
bullets.text: Provided end-to-end production support, led database query optimizations to reduce latency, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles within agile enterprise environments.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my technical and analytical background can support your teams.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG because of its innovative, high-scale e-commerce ecosystem and fast-paced technological environment. My background in building and integrating large-scale enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, combined with my strong techno-functional and stakeholder management skills, aligns well with your technical delivery and client-facing needs.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce, API integration, and stakeholder management experience to drive technical excellence at ABOUT YOU.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw the Technical Account Manager opening at ABOUT YOU and wanted to connect. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce, integration, and stakeholder management experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring a strong techno-functional background. Let's talk!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Technical Account Manager (all genders) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Technical Account Manager position at ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG.

With over 5 years of enterprise experience building and integrating SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong techno-functional skills, API depth, and extensive experience collaborating with international stakeholders.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and am available from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
